title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Rahm Return Decision
items.text: The PGA Tour will discuss Jon Rahm's potential return for the 2027 season during a meeting in early December.

items.headline: Tiger Woods' Upcoming Return
items.text: Tiger Woods is set to return to competition in two weeks at the Hero World Challenge in the Bahamas.

items.headline: Koepka on Scheffler's 2024
items.text: Brooks Koepka said LIV Golf stars would have challenged Scottie Scheffler's dominant 2024 PGA Tour season.
